quest.title: Auction Games
quest.description: After finishing her meal, Ningguang is worried about the auction that her secretaries are in charge of, and so you go to inspect the site with her. What's got her all concerned, you wonder?

talks.objective: Go to the site where the auction is being held
Talk to the secretary in charge of preparations

dialogues.speaker: Observe Vase
dialogues.text: (A plain-looking vase with clear signs of wear and tear.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe Vase
dialogues.text: (Can't see any reason to bid on something like this.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe Writing Tools
dialogues.text: (Generic office implements. I guess they could brighten the place up a little.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe Writing Tools
dialogues.text: (Still, it'd be cheaper to get one from Bolai...)

dialogues.speaker: Observe Hairpin
dialogues.text: (A fairly well-made hairpin, but there's nothing exceptional about it.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe Hairpin
dialogues.text: (Fine to buy in a shop, but can this really fetch a good price at an auction?)

dialogues.speaker: Yingfeng
dialogues.text: Did you bring plenty of Mora with you?

dialogues.speaker: Yingfeng
dialogues.text: Let's put it this way — anything you can snag in one of Lady Ningguang's auctions is practically Mora in the bank. The more you take home, the bigger your fortune.

talks.objective: Wait for the auction to start (16:00 – 18:00)

dialogues.speaker: Little Bin
dialogues.text: Hmm, I can't see anything that particularly interests me...

dialogues.speaker: Little Bin
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang must know what she's doing though. I'm sure she has her reasons.

talks.objective: Figure out what the attendees are thinking

dialogues.speaker: Xiaofei
dialogues.text: Huh? You want to know why I paid so much?

dialogues.speaker: Xiaofei
dialogues.text: Well, it's pretty obvious, isn't it? Because the previous owner was Lady Ningguang.

dialogues.speaker: Xiaofei
dialogues.text: Sure, the item might look pretty ordinary, but that's probably just because I'm not a connoisseur, so I don't know how to appreciate it...

dialogues.speaker: Xiaofei
dialogues.text: But I figured I'd buy it first, then go get it appraised by an expert. Then I'll be rich! Hehe...

talks.objective: Figure out what the attendees are thinking

dialogues.speaker: Yingfeng
dialogues.text: I may have paid an arm and a leg for this, but in the end I got the result I wanted. Hahaha.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you worried about the price being over-inflated?

dialogues.speaker: Yingfeng
dialogues.text: Nothing of Ningguang's could ever be over-inflated.

dialogues.speaker: Yingfeng
dialogues.text: I'm far from the only buyer who believes that "owned by Ningguang" is worth paying a premium for. So how much I make just depends on how many people are even bigger fans of Ningguang than I am!

talks.objective: Figure out what the attendees are thinking

dialogues.speaker: Little Bin
dialogues.text: *sigh* Today wasn't my day. Didn't manage to snag much.

dialogues.speaker: Little Bin
dialogues.text: There were too many bidders, and they all seemed like experts to me.

dialogues.speaker: Little Bin
dialogues.text: I guess I'll just have to wait for the next auction. Someday, I'll be the lucky one.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: While we're waiting for the auction to begin, feel free to check out the lots or just stretch your legs.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Maybe you'll find something that catches your eye.

dialogues.speaker: Hongru
dialogues.text: Thank you for your custom.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Check out the items up for bidding and see if there's anything you might be interested in.

dialogues.speaker: Xiaofei
dialogues.text: Anything Lady Ningguang used to own is sure to be worth a significant amount of money.

dialogues.speaker: Xiaofei
dialogues.text: So even if the price is a little inflated, it should still be fine...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Go ahead and talk to the buyers. They'll give you the answers you're looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I'm sure you will figure out the truth.
